scope: Static post-repair review plus two narrow report regressions. No imports, compilation, tests, CLI, or market-data execution were performed.

test_changes.coverage: The first case omits the final formation date. The second case separately omits a special date and omits an entire configured special clock; both must raise IntegrityError.

repaired_checks_static.date_populations: formation_statistics, special_statistics, and path_statistics now compare exact intended date identities; PIN078 uses the Monday/Tuesday subset.
repaired_checks_static.whole_populations: The frozen plan enumerates expected formation, special, and path clock/horizon identities.
repaired_checks_static.arrow_schema: table_schema(kind) supplies fixed nullable types for all three output tables.
repaired_checks_static.derivation_identity: source_version includes period end, calendar version, analysis-plan ref, and clock recipes.
repaired_checks_static.resource_preflight: The extraction profiles an admitted annual index before root concatenation and enforces a 3,000,000-row aggregate cap plus worker limits.
repaired_checks_static.output_accounting: Checkpoint bytes and both content-addressed/direct narrative copies are included in the bounded output total.

remaining_defects.issue: special_statistics validates date set identity but passes the incoming observation order to metric_intervals instead of the declared chronological intended sequence.
remaining_defects.impact: A reordered special-row collection can change moving date-block bootstrap weights while still passing the set check. The current extract_dates producer emits chronological rows, so this is a bounded adapter robustness gap rather than a current extraction blocker.
remaining_defects.recommendation: Pass the already computed intended tuple to metric_intervals and optionally require actual dates in that order.

resource_support_reported_by_parent.interpretation: Both roots are below the 3M aggregate index cap and share the measured schema; actual worker CPU/RSS receipts remain required because no dynamic execution was performed here.

status: No remaining blocker found in the repaired date/clock/schema/resource paths; one low-severity special-statistics ordering gap remains.
